activities.name: cp_getuomMCPMdata
activities.description: The source query contains two queries for database pims_onshore and pims_offshore to get data from both database.

sqlReaderQuery.value:
select distinct keyuomimperial as UOMCode,keyuomimperial as Description from [dbo].[aviw_ProjectSetup_Tableau_WorkPacksNew] where (keyuomimperial is not NULL OR keyuomimperial not in (''))
union
select distinct keyuommetric as UOMCode,keyuommetric as Description  from [dbo].[aviw_ProjectSetup_Tableau_WorkPacksNew] where (keyuommetric is not NULL OR keyuommetric not in (''))

UNION

select distinct keyuomimperial as UOMCode,keyuomimperial as Description from [pims_offshore].[dbo].[aviw_ProjectSetup_Tableau_WorkPacksNew] where (keyuomimperial is not NULL OR keyuomimperial not in (''))
union
select distinct keyuommetric as UOMCode,keyuommetric as Description  from [pims_offshore].[dbo].[aviw_ProjectSetup_Tableau_WorkPacksNew] where (keyuommetric is not NULL OR keyuommetric not in (''))
